spans.s:
m. (-यः)
A Bauddha.
E.
अ neg. द्वय two.

A unitarian.
E.
अ neg. द्वय two, and वादिन् who speaks, one who acknowledges but one principle.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Only, sole, without a second.
E.
अ neg. द्वितीय second.

mfn. (-षः-षा-षं)
Harmless, not malicious.
E.
अ neg. द्वेष malice.

mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि)
Harmless, inoffensive.
E.
अ neg. द्वेषिन् who hates.

n. (-तं)
Unity, not duality.
E.
अ neg. द्वैत duality.

m. (-दी)
A unitarian, one who maintains the existence of but one principle in the universe.
E.
अद्वैत unity, and वादिन् who speaks.
